top_signals.title: The Biggest Jump in Global Crop Prices Since 2022 Threatens to Boost Inflation
top_signals.summary: Global agriculture prices notched their biggest quarterly jump since Russia’s 2022 invasion of Ukraine, as tensions in the key Black Sea region and extreme weather threaten more inflationary worries for central banks.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Three Tankers Struck by Unknown Projectiles in Strait of Hormuz
top_signals.summary: Three oil tankers have been hit by unknown projectiles while transiting the Strait of Hormuz this week, shipping intelligence and security companies say.   Three Liberia-flagged tankers with their transponders switched off were transiting the Strait on Tuesday and Wednesday when they were hit by projectiles, shipping intelligence firm Marisks says, as carried by Reuters on Thursday.  Earlier this week, the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO), a Royal Navy-sponsored organization, warned it had received three separate…
